SELECT
    e."id",
    e."name",
    e."event_space",
    e."capacity",
    e."address",
    e."contactinfo"
FROM "eventspaces" e
WHERE LOWER(e."event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room')
  AND e."capacity" = 200;
2:
SELECT
    es."id",
    es."name",
    es."event_space",
    es."capacity",
    es."address",
    es."contactinfo"
FROM "eventspaces" es
WHERE es."capacity" = 200
  AND (
        LOWER(es."event_space") LIKE '%banquet%'
     OR LOWER(es."event_space") LIKE '%conference%'
  )
ORDER BY es."name";

FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."cuisine") = 'italian'
  AND LOWER(r."food_service") = 'restaurant'

UNION


SELECT r."name", r."address", r."food_service", r."cuisine"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."cuisine") = 'italian'
  AND LOWER(r."food_service") = 'cafe'

FROM "restaurants" AS r

SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name, lf."feature" AS feature
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE c."name" = 'New York'
  AND lf."feature" ILIKE '%swimming pool%'

UNION


SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name, lf."feature" AS feature
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE c."name" = 'New York'
  AND lf."feature" ILIKE '%hot tub%'
42:
SELECT DISTINCT
    h."name" AS hotel_name,
    h."address" AS hotel_address,
    c."name" AS city_name,
    lf."feature" AS feature
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE LOWER(c."name") = 'new york'
  AND (
      LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%swimming pool%'
      OR LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%hot tub%'
  )
ORDER BY lf."feature", h."name";
43:

JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE LOWER(c."name") = LOWER('New York')
  AND (
    LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%swimming pool%'
    OR LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%hot tub%'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT g."fullname"
FROM "guests" g
JOIN "bookings" b ON b."guestid" = g."id"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
WHERE LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%guest%'

UNION


SELECT DISTINCT g."fullname"
FROM "guests" g
JOIN "bookings" b ON b."guestid" = g."id"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
JOIN "services" s ON s."serviceid" = r."serviceid"
WHERE LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%suite%'
  AND LOWER(s."amenity") LIKE '%air%condition%';

SELECT DISTINCT
    g."fullname" AS guest_name,
    r."typeofroom" AS room_type
FROM "bookings" b
JOIN "guests" g ON g."id" = b."guestid"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
JOIN "services" s ON s."serviceid" = r."serviceid"
WHERE LOWER(s."amenity") LIKE '%air-conditioned%'
  AND (
      LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%room%'
      OR LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%suite%'
  )

SELECT c."channel_value"
FROM "channels" c
JOIN "customer_service_representatives_channels" crc
  ON crc."channel_id" = c."channel_id"
GROUP BY c."channel_id", c."channel_value"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT crc."representative_id") = (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") FROM "customer_service_representatives"
);
164:
SELECT
    csr."id" AS representative_id,
    csr."full_name" AS representative_name,
    c."channel_value" AS channel
FROM "customer_service_representatives" csr
LEFT JOIN "customer_service_representatives_channels" csrc
    ON csr."id" = csrc."representative_id"
LEFT JOIN "channels" c
    ON csrc."channel_id" = c."channel_id"
ORDER BY csr."id", c."channel_value";

312:
SELECT DISTINCT sc."full_name"
FROM "sous_chef" sc
JOIN "restaurant" r ON r."sous_chef_id" = sc."sous_id"
JOIN "orders" o ON o."restaurant_id" = r."restaurant_id"
JOIN "order_details" od ON od."order_id" = o."order_id"
JOIN "menu_items" mi ON mi."menu_item_id" = od."menu_item_id"
WHERE LOWER(mi."item_name") LIKE '%pizza%';
313:
SELECT DISTINCT
    ec."full_name" AS executive_chef_name,
    sc."full_name" AS sous_chef_name
FROM "restaurant" r
JOIN "executive_chef" ec ON ec."chef_id" = r."executive_chef_id"
JOIN "sous_chef" sc ON sc."sous_id" = r."sous_chef_id"
JOIN "orders" o ON o."restaurant_id" = r."restaurant_id"
JOIN "order_details" od ON od."order_id" = o."order_id"
JOIN "menu_items" mi ON mi."menu_item_id" = od."menu_item_id"
WHERE LOWER(mi."item_name") LIKE '%pizza%'
   OR LOWER(mi."description") LIKE '%pizza%';
331:
SELECT
    j."title"        AS vacancy_title,
    j."description"  AS vacancy_description,
    d."degree_level" AS required_degree_level,
    d."certification" AS required_certification,
    d."job_post"     AS required_job_post
FROM "jobs" j
LEFT JOIN "degrees" d
    ON d."job_post" = j."title"
ORDER BY j."title", d."degree_level";
